convoLines.text: Ruby: "Can I ask you something? ... I want us to stick together. Properly. Watch each other's backs."
"All right. Thank you for telling me."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"Can I ask you something? ... I want us to stick together. Properly. Watch each other's backs."
"Stick together, then." They look steadier already.
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"Noted. Filing that under 'extremely useful.' The village needs that."
"Well. Still on what you're good at."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Good question." "Heinrich owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."
"Well. My social battery is officially dead."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
Something eases in their shoulders. "Oh. Okay. That's... that's fine, then."
"Strangers are just people you haven't disappointed yet. That's what my mother said. Terrible advice, but it got me through parties."
"It gave us a codex. You know what that tells me? It expects us to need one. Plan accordingly."
"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
"Still on the big questions."
"Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
"Okay I really have to move now or I'll explode — talk soon!"
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
"I get it. Solitude's a resource too. Scarcer than food, some days."
"I go to the treeline edge and count my breaths. Ten of them. That's my alone. Then I come back — alone is a luxury, and also a little bit a lie."
"Still on needing to be alone. ...if that makes sense."
"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
"...Never mind me. What were you going to say?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "Heinrich always took the burnt piece. Said someone had to. I take it now."
"I keep turning over the last thing Heinrich said to me. I can't tell if I'm remembering it right, and that's somehow the worst part."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Ruby grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Ashanti is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
"I asked Sofia about that question — Sofia's gone. What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"God, yes. That's the dream now. Eight hours of not being afraid. I mean it."
They pull back half a step — not leaving, just... further.
"Still on what you're hoping for. ...sorry."
"Anyway — that's my problem, not yours. What did you want?"

"Huh. I answered that once — back when the answer was simpler." "The whole fire was arguing about The Anaconda Empress last night — what to even CALL it. 'Don't-Look' got shouted down. What's your vote?"
"Take your time."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
"My part? I taste the water before the others drink and stay neutral until there's a winner."
🤝 Ashanti is already 👁️ Scout — that promise is theirs.
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
You show them Black Walnut — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."
"Right. Go on, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"There's more, but that's for another fire."
They shake their head, then nod — both true at once. "Talk to me a bit. That helps more than anything."
"Have you heard what they're calling The Anaconda Empress? I'm pushing 'The Loud Thing'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
They nod. "Okay."
"With you leading? ...Give me a day to think."
You show them Black Walnut — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."
"I should go. Before I overthink this conversation too."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"About that question — Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
They nod, slow. "Okay. Thank you for telling me. That couldn't have been easy to say."
Their friendliness thins — still there, just held at arm's length.
"Still on whether you've hurt someone."
"Look, forget it. You wanted something?"
"Last time things were different. They always are." "Sofia is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Ashanti is already 👁️ Scout — that promise is theirs.
"I wish there was more to tell. That's it."
"You're a good listener, you know that?" A tired smile.
"Anyway." A small smile.
You show them Aconite (Monkshood) — where it grows, how to tell it apart. They nod slowly, committing it to memory. "Good to know. Really good to know."
"Sure. I'll be around."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Black Walnut — I keep thinking about what you said. I'm seeing it everywhere now."
"Walk my trap line with me? Extra hands, extra eyes."
You walk to the trap line with Dakota. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.
"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
"Still on that plant lesson."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"I should go. You know where to find me."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"This was good." They mean it.
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"I think — Good. Keep counting. The days need witnesses."
"I count meals, not days. Three meals since the rain. Two since the alarm. Days are for people with calendars. I have a stomach."
"...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.
"What's this about? Still on what day it is."
"All right. Thank you for asking."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Their eyes do the math before their mouth does. You can see the calculation happening.
"I don't actually want to belong somewhere. I want to keep the peace. I keep my head down. Old habit. It kept me alive before; it keeps me alive now."
"That again?" Esteban sighs. "I confessed that already. I'm not confessing it twice for dramatic effect."
Esteban looks at you, level. "I told you the truth. You can keep poking it, but it's told."
Ashanti nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Right. Go on, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"Right. Well." That's the whole goodbye.

lines: d6: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d6: 🕯️ Heinrich Stepanov is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d6: What Heinrich kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d6: Sofia picks up the journal. Their hands shake. Then they open it, and keep writing.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d6: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d6: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d6: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d6: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Heinrich Stepanov, 6 days. The mantle passes to Sofia Chen.
d6: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Sofia Chen, 29 — a community gardener. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm.
d11: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Sofia Chen is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d11: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d11: 🕯️ Sofia Chen is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d11: What Sofia kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d11: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ruby blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d11: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d11: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d11: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d11: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Sofia Chen, 11 days. The mantle passes to Ruby Pang.
d11: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ruby Pang, 35 — an interpreter. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach.
d11: You knew Sofia — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
d11: The fire knew Ruby before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d32: — DAY 32 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d32: The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Chinese Chestnut — named and noted.
d32: 👀 Someone asks Ruth a shop-talk question about journalist work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
d32: 💬 Esteban says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."
d32: Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 31 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
